title: Marching on the Machines
description: This week: protesters show up outside OpenAI, Anthropic, and DeepMind demanding a slowdown, and AI-generated bots start texting voters like they're your friend from high school. Plus, early retirements, a smarter watch, and running agents straight from your browser. Claude and ChatGPT try to talk about themselves without it getting weird. It gets a little weird.
